title: Intune Device Report
subtitle: A Microsoft Graph export for Intune-managed devices.
summary: Maintaining visibility of managed devices is essential in modern endpoint environments. I created a reporting solution that connects to Microsoft Graph and exports Intune-managed device information into CSV format.
prompt: Use this page to preview the Intune compliance reporting workflow, the exported device fields, and the PowerShell that builds the CSV report.

blocks.title: What It Does
blocks.text: The report includes compliance status, operating system details, ownership information, and assigned users.

blocks.title: Sample Script
blocks.code:
Connect-MgGraph `
    -Scopes DeviceManagementManagedDevices.Read.All

$Devices = Get-MgDeviceManagementManagedDevice -All

$Report = foreach ($Device in $Devices)
{
    [PSCustomObject]@{
        DeviceName       = $Device.DeviceName
        User             = $Device.UserPrincipalName
        OS               = $Device.OperatingSystem
        OSVersion        = $Device.OsVersion
        ComplianceState  = $Device.ComplianceState
        LastSync         = $Device.LastSyncDateTime
        Ownership        = $Device.ManagedDeviceOwnerType
    }
}

$Report |
Sort-Object DeviceName |
Export-Csv `
".\\Intune_Device_Report.csv" `
-NoTypeInformation

Write-Host "Report generated successfully."
